info.name: LurePilot AI
info.description: Backend API collection for LurePilot AI MVP, including fishing spots, lures, fish library, plans, sessions, session lifecycle, catch gallery, managed catch photo uploads, AI recommendations, insights, frontend options and Open-Meteo weather snapshots. The React Native Web frontend uses the fish/lure library endpoints for image-based catalogue CRUD and the gallery endpoints for photo-based catch history. Uploads accept JPEG, PNG, WEBP and GIF files up to 10 MB and return a URL for catch records.

request.description: Returns dashboard counters plus next planned session, active sessions, recent results, best recent lure, latest catch image reference, success rate, relevant weather snapshot and pending recommendation evaluations.

Returns a paged gallery of catch photos. Each item includes catchId, sessionId and the optional lure library item with its name and image, so the frontend can open the related session and show the lure used. The visual gallery prioritizes the image and keeps the normal detail focused on size, optional weight, session and spot.

query.description: true returns only catches with photoUrl; false returns all catches
Allowed: id, catchId, sessionDate, sessionStartTime, spotName, species, quantity, sizeCm, weightKg, released

Returns practical top lures based on session usage, successful sessions and catches. Optional filters: dateFrom, dateTo, species, spotId, lureId and limit.
